name: agent-orchestration
description: Turn one explicitly designated Codex task into a Goal Mode control plane that finishes one foreground issue through a tested PR or blocker with independent exact-head review.

interface.longDescription: Explicitly turns the current Codex task into a project-scoped Goal Mode control plane that clarifies the operator objective, selects one foreground issue, carries it through a tested linked draft PR or recoverable blocker, runs same-candidate review and verification asynchronously when safe, coordinates bounded waits without reviewing code itself, and archives and safely cleans every terminal session.
defaultPrompt: Make this task the control plane for the current project and finish one foreground issue at a time.
Run same-candidate implementation, verification, and exact-head review in separate tasks; never self-review.
Resume this orchestration task and close out completed work.
